definition: The study of how to automatically learn useful features or representations of data, rather than relying on hand-engineered features.
details: Representation learning is a core theme underlying deep learning's success, since neural networks trained on large datasets automatically discover representations that are often more effective than manually designed features.
story: Picture a librarian organizing a million slips of paper so that any one of them can be found in a heartbeat. Here is the short version: The study of how to automatically learn useful features or representations of data, rather than relying on hand-engineered features. The part that makes it sing: Representation learning is a core theme underlying deep learning's success, since neural networks trained on large datasets automatically discover representations that are often more effective than manually designed features. Garbage in, garbage out — and the reverse: clean, representative data makes the model quietly brilliant. And that is Representation Learning — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
